name: Chipotle Corn Salsa
desc: Copycat Chipotle corn salsa with fire-roasted poblano, jalapeno, red onion, lemon, and lime.

source.title: Chipotle Corn Salsa (Copycat)
source.evidence: Same eight ingredients in the same amounts (24 oz frozen corn, 1/2 cup red onion, 1 poblano, 2 jalapenos, 1/4 cup cilantro, 1 tbsp each lemon and lime) and the same cook-cool-combine method.

ingredients.raw: 2 jalapeño peppers, stemmed, seeded, and finely chopped

steps: Turn a gas burner to high. Holding the poblano with tongs, roast it directly over the flame, turning, until charred and blistered on all sides, 2 to 3 minutes.
Put the poblano in a bowl, cover tightly, and let steam 10 minutes. Rub off the skin, remove the stem and seeds, and finely chop.
Meanwhile, cook the corn according to the package directions, drain well, and spread on a baking sheet to cool.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled corn, red onion, poblano, jalapeños, cilantro, lemon juice, and lime juice. Season with salt and serve.
